description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.512202
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their owners, extents, encumbrances, and legal status related to land ownership. The document is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land settlement matters, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
